# Create the NFR

Prerequisites: BRD, PRD, and FRD have explicit human approval. Read those
artifacts and do not edit them.

Create or update only `docs/requirements/NFR.md`. Define verifiable
requirements for privacy, security boundaries, input safety, accessibility,
usability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and testability. For
each requirement provide an ID, priority, and verification method. Keep
deployment local unless approved otherwise. State limitations; do not promise
production readiness or compliance.

End with an approval checklist and stop before Logical Architecture.
